card.name: Words leading into breadth or specificity
card.fires_on: Words just before a term about how broad or narrow something is, such as specificity, spectrum, range or host range. Seen in drug labels and biology texts.

modes.label: Before specificity
modes.description: Words like 'lack of' or 'selectivity' that lead into specificity of tests or targets.
modes.example: This is due to lack<< of>> specificity of the screening tests.

modes.label: Breadth of action or range
modes.description: Words like 'broader' or 'spectrum' that lead into coverage, distribution or host range.
modes.example: It has much the same<< spectrum>> of activity -- works on weeds, nem

modes.label: Host or target range
modes.description: Words such as 'host' or 'not' in studies of which organisms are affected.
modes.example: is a larval<< host>> and/or nectar source for: Root

card.writes: It pushes toward words about breadth, range, narrowness and specificity (including Chinese terms like 范围 and 窄).
card.plain: It marks spots where the text is about to talk about how wide or narrow the range or specificity of something is.
